name: frontdesk
description: Arvo Systems Frontdesk V3.2 support ticketing

scripts.build: npm run build -w @frontdesk/contracts && npm run build -w @frontdesk/api && npm run build -w @frontdesk/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @frontdesk/contracts && npm run typecheck -w @frontdesk/api && npm run typecheck -w @frontdesk/web && tsc -p tests/tsconfig.json --noEmit
scripts.test: npm run test:calendar && npm run test:release-gate && npm run test:unit && npm run test:integration
scripts.db:up: docker compose -p frontdesk --env-file .env -f infrastructure/docker/compose.yaml up -d --wait postgres
scripts.test:proofs: npm run test:calendar && jest --selectProjects unit --testPathPattern 'tests/unit/(domain/|openapi|app-boundaries)' && jest --selectProjects integration --runInBand --testPathPattern 'proof-|remediation-|db-security|db-constraints|sweep-store|http-'
scripts.test:e2e: npm run build -w @frontdesk/contracts && npm run build -w @frontdesk/api && npm run e2e:db && playwright test
scripts.docker:build: docker build --target runtime -t frontdesk-app:local . && docker build --target migrate -t frontdesk-migrate:local .
scripts.monitoring:up: docker compose -p frontdesk-prod --env-file .env.production.local -f infrastructure/docker/compose.prod.yaml --profile monitoring up -d --no-build --wait
